title: Bram and the Alibi
author: U. M. Iversen
blurb: Vesper Ishikawa, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
